selected_script.angle: Tired dad enters dressed in full biohazard gear to save dry leftovers using a steam-assisted microwave splatter cover.
selected_script.hook: Close-up of a rock-hard, dried-out pizza slice sizzling and curling up inside a dirty microwave.
scene_order: 1.5-3s: absurd adult family rescuer with product

script_record.pain_point: Reheated leftovers become rock hard, dry, and splatter food oil all over the microwave walls.
script_record.conflict_hook: Dry curling pizza slice heating up in a messy microwave.
script_record.product_solution: Cover plate with UFORU microwave splatter cover, fill side reservoir with water, and steam-reheat perfectly moist food.

timeline.scene: Close-up of a rock-hard, dried-out pizza slice sizzling and curling inside a microwave with greasy splatter stains.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An adult father dressed in full yellow hazard suit enters, holding the clear UFORU cover with olive-green handle and shouting 'Not on my watch!'
Father places the transparent cover over the pizza plate, pours a small splash of water into the side clear reservoir, and turns on the microwave.
Juicy, steam-reheated pizza pulled out with soft melted cheese pull, microwave interior remaining spotlessly clean.
Pouring a small amount of water into the side reservoir and covering a bowl of rice and chicken meal prep inside a home kitchen.
Easily lifting the cover by its top olive-green arched handle and pouring excess condensation water out through the bottom drainage outlet.
Text on screen: 'Keep food moist & microwave clean. Check it out today!'

script_record.cta: Keep food moist & microwave clean. Check it out today!
